name: Levy Count
description: Count the levy each hostile source owes and which of them can be collected first.

name: Collected Levy
description: Collect a levy of soul force from a hostile source at the moment its technique lands.

name: Levy Cover
description: Spread a cover of soul force that takes its levy from a mental blow before the blow lands.

name: Compounding Levy
description: Let each levy collected raise the next so the reserve grows faster as the fight goes on.

name: Exacting Rebound
description: Throw a soul strike back with its own levy added to the force it carried.

name: Debt Cleansing
description: Take a curse on an ally as a debt and collect it from the soul as plain force.

name: Seizing Pull
description: Seize a share of a target's force and hold it from the target for several breaths.

name: Grand Levy
description: Levy every hostile source in reach at once and pour the whole yield into the reserve.

name: Levy Surge
description: Surge the levied force back out in a ring that strikes every soul that paid it.

name: Azure Exaction
description: Exact the whole force of an incoming soul attack and absorb it into the reserve before it lands.

name: Total Levy
description: Collect a levy from every soul in range at once and leave each with its force drained to a thread.

name: Rich Marking
description: Mark from above which hostile technique carries the richest force to take.

name: Swift Reaping
description: Reap the force of a hostile technique in one swift pass as it flies.

name: Plumed Shield
description: Spread a plumed shield of soul force that sheds mental blows and keeps their force.

name: Laden Flight
description: Carry drawn force aloft as the user circles and add to the load with each pass.

name: Rending Snatch
description: Snatch a target's gathered technique apart in a single rending stoop.

name: Cleansing Talon
description: Hook a binding out of an ally's soul with a talon of soul force and burn it for fuel.

name: Gorging Dive
description: Dive on a soul with the gorged reserve and pierce its guard with all the force held.

name: Heavy Hoard
description: Build a heavy hoard of drawn force over a long fight that lifts every later technique.

name: Raptor's Maw
description: Open a hawk's maw of soul force that swallows an incoming soul attack whole.

name: Apex Harvest
description: Gather the whole yield of a fight high above and drop it as one crushing blow on every foe below.

name: Anchor Perception
description: Read through the soul anchor how much soul-type force a foe is directing at the user.

name: Anchored Intake
description: Draw incoming soul force into the anchor at the Core and keep it there.

name: Anchored Plate
description: Set a plate of soul force at the anchor so mental blows spend themselves against it.

name: Seated Pull
description: Pull at a target's force from the seat of the Core and thin it by a share.

name: Core Conversion
description: Convert the soul damage the user takes into usable soul force held at the Core.

name: Deep Rebound
description: Rebound a soul strike from the depth of the anchor with the force it carried and more.

name: Anchored Cleansing
description: Draw soul erosion from an ally into the anchor and convert it to plain soul force.

name: Reservoir Lash
description: Lash a target's soul with a whip of force from the reservoir.

name: Deep Reservoir
description: Deepen the reservoir at the Core so it holds a vast store of drawn force.

name: Reservoir Surge
description: Surge the reservoir's force out through the soul in a wave that strikes every soul near.

name: Anchor Absorption
description: Take a soul attack into the anchor whole and convert all of its force at once.

name: Crowning Draw
description: Open the whole reach of the Core to draw every hostile force in range into the reserve at once.

name: Gust Accounting
description: Tally the force carried on each gust of battle and mark the richest.

name: Wind Siphon
description: Siphon force from a hostile technique on the wind as it passes the user.

name: Gale Sponge
description: Soak a gale of hostile intent into the soul like a sponge and wring out only the dregs.

name: Spinning Intake
description: Spin the draw in a wheel so every hostile force it touches is drawn into the reserve.

name: Turned Gust
description: Turn a hostile gust about on itself and send it back at the one who loosed it.

name: Breeze Cleansing
description: Pass a clean breeze of drawn force through an ally's soul and carry off the taint.

name: Squall Siphon
description: Siphon the force of a whole storm of techniques into the reserve with no pause.

name: Gale Lash
description: Lash every soul before the user with the stored force loosed as a gale.

name: Whirling Maw
description: Spin a cyclone maw of soul force that absorbs every hostile force it takes in.

name: Tempest Draw
description: Whirl every hostile force in range into one gale and draw it whole into the reserve.

name: Fullness Reading
description: Read how near the vessel stands to its brim and how much more it can take.

name: Vessel Filling
description: Fill the vessel of the soul from a hostile source a little at a time.

name: Sealed Cover
description: Seal the vessel's mouth with a cover of soul force so nothing drawn can spill.

name: Held Brim
description: Hold the vessel at its brim through a long exchange without losing a drop.

name: Brim Rebound
description: Let a hostile blow strike the full vessel and rebound with the brim's weight behind it.

name: Steadfast Purge
description: Hold a steady draw on a curse in an ally until the vessel has taken it all.

name: Weighted Siphon
description: Add the weight of the full vessel to a siphon on a target until its force sags.

name: Fullness Draw
description: Keep drawing at the brim and let the vessel stretch to take far more than it could.

name: Brimful Return
description: Return the brimming store through a soul's guard in one unspilled thrust.

name: Unspilled Absorption
description: Absorb a hostile soul attack into the full vessel and let no part of it spill.

name: Vessel Entire
description: Fill the soul to its brim from every hostile force in range and hold it there without spilling a drop.

name: Zenith Tally
description: Tally from the peak of the soul's reach the hostile force available below.

name: Crest Intake
description: Draw force to the peak of the reach and let it fall into the Core.

name: Core Sheath
description: Sheathe the soul in a layer of Core-fed force that blunts hostile soul strikes.

name: Anchored Bleeding
description: Drain a share of a target's force into the anchor from across open space.

name: Conversion Run
description: Run the incoming soul force through the anchor and turn it into fuel as it arrives.

name: Anchor Rebound
description: Rebound a soul strike off the anchor with the force it carried turned against the striker.

name: Zenith Cleansing
description: Reach from the peak to draw a curse out of an ally and convert it to plain force.

name: Core-Fed Lance
description: Drive a lance of Core-fed soul force through a soul's guard.

name: Filled Reserve
description: Raise the reservoir to its summit so it holds a store of converted force no foe can match.

name: Heavy Outflow
description: Surge the converted force from the peak down upon every soul within the user's reach.

name: Zenith Absorption
description: Absorb a soul attack at the peak of the reach and convert all of its force.

name: Zenith Reaping
description: Reap every soul-type force in the full reach of the Core and convert it into one great store.
